name: mcp-agent-brokerage-resolver
description: MCP server for Agent to Brokerage Resolver. Look up a licensed US real estate agent on the official state register and get the brokerage of record, its active agent count and size band, and license status. 19 states; firm and zip rosters. No emails or phones. Runs on Apify. Clay-ready output.
